title: The beginning of Home
body:
Helmet hud is implemented, pistol system, recoil system,Simple ai system for the enemies, Voice comms and dynamic crosshair.
Note pistol is not done it at 18%.

title: Weapon Updates
body: Weapons have been given ads now so you can aim with a scope (We still deciding if it should be kept in the game or not),grenades have been added.

title: Weapon update 2
body:
Grenades no longer have a ui bar.
When you pickup weapons it play a  animation ,same for equip and unequip.

title: Game redesign
body:
Since we are targeting a horror game that feels like Doom 3 x Deadspace me and my team had to scrap out a lot from the updates 
Mantling is intact
weapons have been removed but will be implemented later on
Movement are still the same 
And we added a wristwatch hologram projector for "audio log,note log and so on" as well as a wrist ui to check health,stamina and battery pod. This was inspired from deadspace but redesign to our direction.
this is not the final look yet even for the prototype

title: Audio log system
body: We have the player interacting with the system to get an audio log and the audio also uses realtime  voice to create the sythentic wave lines.
